Divination Enhancement.description: From 3rd level onward, whenever the divine oracle casts a divination spell (such as augury or divination), she may make two rolls and use whichever result is more favorable.

Immune to Surprise.description: At 10th level, the divine oracle's awareness of impending threats becomes so finely tuned that she can never be caught off guard. She is always able to act during a surprise round by taking a standard action, provided she is not physically prevented from doing so. If no surprise round occurs, this ability has no effect.

Improved Uncanny Dodge (Can't Be Flanked.description: At 6th level and higher, the divine oracle can no longer be flanked, since she can react to opponents on opposite sides of her as easily as she can react to a single attacker. This defense denies rogues the ability to use flank attacks to sneak attack the divine oracle. The exception to this defense is when an attacker has at least 4 more rogue levels than the target has divine oracle levels. If a character already has levels of a class that could gain uncanny dodge, the levels from the classes that grant uncanny dodge stack to determine the minimum level a rogue must be to flank the character.
Improved Uncanny Dodge (Can't Be Flanked.seedName: Improved Uncanny Dodge (Can't Be Flanked) (Divine Oracle)

Oracle Domain.description: When a character enters this prestige class, she gains access to the Oracle domain. She receives its granted power (a +2 bonus to caster level for divination spells) and may select spells from that domain as her daily domain spell choices.

Prescient Sense.description: Starting at 2nd level, when the divine oracle succeeds on a Reflex saving throw against an effect that normally deals half damage on a successful save (such as a dragon's breath weapon or a fireball), she instead suffers no damage at all due to her prophetic awareness allowing her to avoid the danger entirely. Unlike the standard evasion ability available to monks and rogues, this works regardless of what armor the divine oracle is wearing.

Scry Bonus.description: The divine oracle receives a +1 sacred bonus to the saving throw DC of all divination (scrying) spells she casts.

Spells per Day/Spells Known.description: The divine oracle continues to develop her spellcasting power alongside her prestige class abilities. Each time she gains a new divine oracle level, she gains additional spells per day (and spells known, if relevant) as though she had also advanced one level in a spellcasting class she belonged to prior to taking this prestige class. She does not, however, receive any other class benefits from that prior class (such as improved undead turning, wild shape, or similar abilities). In effect, the divine oracle level is added to the previous spellcasting class level for the purpose of calculating spells per day. If the character had multiple spellcasting classes before becoming a divine oracle, she must choose which class benefits from each level of divine oracle for spellcasting progression purposes.

Trap Sense.description: At 2nd level, the divine oracle develops an instinctive awareness of danger posed by traps, granting a +1 bonus on Reflex saves to avoid traps and a +1 dodge bonus to AC against trap attacks. This bonus increases to +2 at 5th level and +3 at 8th level.

Uncanny Dodge (Dex Bonus to Ac).description: From 4th level onward, the divine oracle can sense danger before she would normally perceive it. She retains her Dexterity bonus to AC (if any) even when caught flat-footed or targeted by an unseen attacker. She does still lose her Dexterity bonus to AC if she is rendered immobile.
